fields.title: Every EPUB archive is opened through one size-checked door
fields.description: A new async `openZip` in `main/zip-read.js` checks the archive's size on disk against `ZIP_FILE_MAX_BYTES` (512 MiB) before adm-zip reads it. All five EPUB opens use it. It adds tests for a STORED entry with a lying header and for the per-operation cap at parser level.
